chunks: Man will fly from his brother,
ai.seo_question: Why will people flee from their brothers on the Day of Judgment?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the ultimate dissolution of social ties as the individual's focus shifts entirely to self-preservation before Allah, fulfilling the prophecy of Surah At-Takwir. Scholars note that the 'brother' here symbolizes the closest kinship, emphasizing that even the strongest human bonds are rendered secondary to the weight of one's deeds. This scene serves as a stark reminder of the accountability that renders worldly relationships irrelevant in the Hereafter.
